opening_source_note: official Mountopolis opening-hours page (2025/26 archived copy, 2026/27 live) + forum
score_notes: Harakiri 78% piste and Penken/Rastkogel off-piste with local freeride guiding (skiresort 'top for freeriders'); Mayrhofen is the gateway for Zillertal Alps spring touring (Berliner Hütte, Schwarzenstein) and Tuxer Voralpen day tours.
comments: Fixed price: 1-day adult 79 EUR in 2025/26, 82 EUR (from 08:00) in 2026/27; Mayrhofen pass max 1.5 days, 2+ days only as Zillertaler Superskipass; 2025/26 Horberg+Penken opened 05.12.2025, Ahorn 13.12.2025; 2026/27 Ahorn from 12.12.2026; +2 EUR keycard deposit; from Italy via Brenner, no pass closures.

opening_source_note: winter-tariff start dates: official 2026/27 price page; 2025/26 per skiinfo price table
piste_km_basis: Hintertux glacier-only 1-day pass; official 'up to 64 km'
score_notes: Large glacier off-piste (Gefrorene Wand, Kaserer, Larmstange runs) with reliable snow and local guiding but no contest history; touring: classic Tuxer Alps spring objectives (Olperer, Hoher Riffler) from the glacier and Tuxer Joch, typical of Austrian glacier resorts.
comments: Year-round glacier (365-day marketing); 2025/26: glacier reopened for skiing 27.09.2025 after late-summer break (forum), winter tariff 79 EUR valid 04.10.2025-10.05.2026; 2026/27: autumn tariff 68 EUR until 02.10.2026, winter tariff 82 EUR (from 08:00) 03.10.2026-07.05.2027, also valid in Ski- & Gletscherwelt Zillertal 3000 04.12.2026-11.04.2027; +2 EUR keycard; 2+ day tickets only as Zillertaler Superskipass; official webcam page is JS-rendered (alt. https://www.bergfex.com/hintertux/webcams/); from Italy via Brenner, Tux valley road open all year.

opening_source_note: meinbezirk 20.11.2025 + forum (Hochfügen weekend ops); 2026/27 official price page
piste_km_basis: Ski-optimal Hochzillertal-Hochfügen pass; official 'up to 90.7 km' (skiresort 89 km)
score_notes: Hochfügen's high basin is a well-known Tyrolean freeride spot (skiresort: 'paradise for freeriders', untouched slopes into spring); Tuxer Voralpen give popular but moderate day tours (Gilfert, Rastkogel).
comments: 2025/26: Hochfügen weekend ops 22-23 and 29-30.11.2025, Kaltenbach weekend 29-30.11.2025, continuous daily ops from 05.12.2025; 2026/27 continuous ops published 05.12.2026-11.04.2027 (earlier weekend openings possible, not published); price is full-day ticket from 07:30, no seasonal split, 1 EUR less with guest card; official highest point 'almost 2,400 m' (skiresort 2378 m); from Italy via Brenner, no pass closures.

opening_source_note: official operating-hours page (2026/27); 2025/26 official announcement quoted in forum
piste_km_basis: Zillertal Arena full pass (only pass sold); official 150 km
score_notes: Decent lift-accessed off-piste around Gerlos/Königsleiten (Isskogel, Übergangsjoch bowls) but no contest history or guiding scene of note; touring limited to moderate day tours from Gerlos (Kreuzjoch, Salzachgeier, Wildgerlostal).
comments: 2025/26 area opened 05.12.2025 (Karspitzbahn Zell, Gerlos, Königsleiten); Rosenalmbahn Zell reopened 12.12.2025 after modernisation; 2026/27 official start 04.12.2026 for all valley lifts (skiinfo aggregator lists 05.12/12.12.2026 - conflict, official used); fixed price, 1-day from 08:00 82 EUR, 2+ days = Zillertaler Superskipass; from Italy via Brenner, no pass closures.

opening_source_note: official KitzSki timetable 2026/27; 2025/26 snowplaza 30.10.2025 + forum photos 08.11.2025
piste_km_basis: KitzSki full pass; skiresort 188 km pistes (+45 km ski routes)
score_notes: Dedicated Bichlalm freeride area and Zweitausender/Resterhöhe off-piste, but low grass mountains with limited steep terrain and no contest history; touring: popular easy Kitzbühel Alps day tours (Bichlalm, Kitzbüheler Horn) with modest variety.
comments: Price = Premium-Saison 20.12.2026-13.03.2027 ticket-office price 83 EUR (Vorteils 76, Spar 69); online booking cheaper (flexible online pricing); 2025/26: Resterkogel (Pass Thurn) from 07.11.2025 weekends only via snow-farming, Hahnenkamm/Fleckalm from 22.11.2025, Horn 06.12.2025, full link 12.12.2025; 2026/27 Resterkogel 06.11.2026, Hahnenkamm 21-22.11.2026, core area 27/28.11.2026; base = Hahnenkammbahn; from Italy via Brenner-Inntal or Felbertauern tunnel (toll) + Pass Thurn (open winter).

opening_source_note: lift-company announcement (tt.com 24.11.2025, forum); 2026/27 official ticket page

score_notes: Schatzberg offers some off-piste but no contest history (Open Faces events were on the Alpbach side); Wildschönau is a popular gentle ski-touring area (Feldalphorn, Breiteggern, Schatzberg) with many easy documented tours but low altitude.
comments: Area first day 29.11.2025 was at Wiedersbergerhorn (Alpbach side); Wildschönau's own Schatzberg lifts (Auffach) opened 05.12.2025 (published 05.12.25-06.04.26); villages Niederau/Oberau/Auffach, base = Schatzbergbahn valley station Auffach (Markbachjochbahn Niederau alternative); 2026/27 peak season 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 71.50 EUR, pre/late season 64.50, fixed prices; from Italy via Brenner-Inntal, no passes.

piste_km_basis: Skicircus full pass (Ski ALPIN CARD, only pass sold); official 270 km
score_notes: Freeride World Tour stop (Wildseeloder face) and self-styled freeride capital of Austria with strong guiding/freeride-camp scene; touring only moderate Kitzbühel Alps day tours (Wildseeloder, Henne).
comments: 2025/26 Fieberbrunn lifts F1/F2 Streuböden, F4 Lärchfilzen, F6 Zillstatt ran from Skicircus opening day 28.11.2025 (season to 06.04.2026); 2026/27 planned 27.11.2026-04.04.2027; price = peak season 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 82 EUR, all tickets are Ski ALPIN CARD (also valid Schmitten Zell am See, Kitzsteinhorn/Maiskogel), +2 EUR keycard; 2096 m is the full Skicircus maximum; from Italy via Brenner-Inntal or Felbertauern tunnel (toll).
